title: Downloadable ZIP build artifacts UI and deployment documentation for Speed Motors ERP

requirements.summary: Stage generated ZIP artifacts and SOURCE_CODE.md as frontend-served static files under /artifacts/ for download.
acceptanceCriteria: Running the existing packaging workflow generates both frontend/public/artifacts/app-build.zip and frontend/public/artifacts/source-code.zip (and stages frontend/public/artifacts/SOURCE_CODE.md).
When the app is running, HEAD/GET requests to /artifacts/app-build.zip, /artifacts/source-code.zip, and /artifacts/SOURCE_CODE.md return 200 responses (when artifacts have been generated).
The artifacts contain the expected contents per the packaging script: compiled backend canister output, frontend dist build, and included documentation/source code bundle as applicable.

file_operations.description: Ensure the packaging workflow consistently stages artifacts to frontend/public/artifacts/ (including app-build.zip, source-code.zip, and SOURCE_CODE.md) and keeps the final artifact names/paths aligned with the acceptance criteria. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Document the expected artifact output locations (frontend/public/artifacts/*) and the runtime URLs under /artifacts/ so artifact availability checks and user downloads match the packaging workflow. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Keep the public artifacts directory tracked and add brief guidance (via comments if applicable) that generated files are expected to appear here for static serving at /artifacts/. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add an in-app download dialog reachable from the main layout that checks artifact availability via HEAD and provides download actions for available files.
acceptanceCriteria: The UI includes a clearly labeled section or dialog (reachable from the main layout) with download links/buttons for: /artifacts/app-build.zip, /artifacts/source-code.zip, and /artifacts/SOURCE_CODE.md.
The UI uses the existing static artifact availability check (HEAD-based) to show whether each artifact is available, and disables/hides download actions when unavailable.
Clicking an available download link triggers a browser download for the corresponding artifact file.

file_operations.description: Create a reusable download UI using shadcn-ui Dialog/Button/Badge primitives to list each artifact (app-build.zip, source-code.zip, SOURCE_CODE.md), show availability status from useStaticArtifactAvailability, and provide download buttons/links that trigger browser downloads only when available. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the new ArtifactsDownloadDialog into the main layout header as an additional button (alongside search/export) so it is reachable from anywhere in the app; manage open/close state and ensure the dialog uses the existing availability hook. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add translation keys/labels for the new artifacts download UI (title, description, availability statuses, and action labels) so the new dialog follows the app’s existing i18n pattern. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Write complete English deployment instructions in DEPLOY_README.md for the packaged app-build.zip contents and deployment flow.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/artifacts/DEPLOY_README.md contains step-by-step, English instructions describing what app-build.zip includes, how to extract it, and how to deploy/run it using the Internet Computer tooling expected by this project.
DEPLOY_README.md is included at the root of app-build.zip (as currently intended by the packaging script).

file_operations.description: Expand the deployment guide into a complete, step-by-step English README covering: what app-build.zip contains (backend canister build output + frontend dist + docs), extraction steps, prerequisites (dfx/pnpm), local deploy/run steps consistent with this repo, and verification checks after deployment. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
